cases.name: Ella Diebolt Jackson
cases.narrative: On 4/29/2020, her partial skeletal remains were found by several residents in a wooded area off South U.S. 27, about 3 miles from the McCreary County line, near a property he owned. He had already been arrested after investigators found a significant amount of her blood in the trunk of his vehicle. “It is a reasonable inference that Ella is no longer alive, that she met her death through criminal means at her residence on Oct. 20, 2019, and (Glenn Jackson) intentionally caused the death of his wife,” Glenn Jackson's arrest citation reads.
